text.p: Tropical depression 5e is only a minor threat to shipping about 600 miles south of the southern tip of Baja. This system should dissipate within the next 24 hours.

Tropical depression 1 has formed in the western Atlantic and is located about 250 miles south-southeast of Hatteras North Carolina. This system is mainly a risk to shipping as it moves east and then north during this period. It is expected to remain fairly weak during this time.
There are no further statements at this time.
